tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than 30 days after the date of transfer pursuant to section 460lll–41 of this title, the Secretary and the Tennessee Valley Authority shall enter into a memorandum of agreement concerning implementation of this subchapter.

tree.heading: Provisions
tree.text: The memorandum of understanding shall provide procedures for—

children.text: the orderly withdrawal of officers and employees of the Tennessee Valley Authority;
the transfer of property, fixtures, and facilities;
the interagency transfer of officers and employees;

children.heading: In general
children.text: The memorandum of understanding may provide for a transition team consisting of the Tennessee Valley Authority and Forest Service employees.

children.heading: Duration
children.text: The team may continue in existence after the date of transfer.

children.heading: Personnel costs
children.text: The Tennessee Valley Authority and the Forest Service shall pay personnel costs of their respective team members.
